children.name: Todea
children.description: Todea — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Todea barbara
children.description: Todea barbara, known as the king fern or crape fern, is a fern in the family Osmundaceae occurring in moist areas of south eastern Australia, and also indigenous to New Zealand, Australia and South Africa.

children.name: Todea papuana
children.description: The native range of this species is Papua New Guinea.

children.name: Leptopteris alpina
children.description: The native range of this species is Maluku (Seram) to New Guinea. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Leptopteris fraseri
children.description: Leptopteris fraseri, commonly known as the crepe fern, is a species of plant occurring in eastern Australia.

children.name: Leptopteris hymenophylloides
children.description: Leptopteris hymenophylloides, which is commonly called single crepe fern is a fern in the family Osmundaceae.

children.name: Leptopteris superba

children.name: Leptopteris wilkesiana
children.description: Leptopteris wilkesiana is a species of tree fern.

children.name: Osmunda lancea
children.description: Osmunda lancea is a fern in the genus Osmunda, section Euosmunda.

children.name: Osmunda pilosa

children.name: Osmunda regalis
children.description: Osmunda regalis, or royal fern, is a species of deciduous fern, native to Europe, North Africa and West Asia, growing in woodland bogs and on the banks of streams.

children.name: Osmunda spectabilis
children.description: Osmunda spectabilis, known as American royal fern, is a species of fern native to a large area of the New World, from the eastern half of Canada and the United States to Argentina.

children.name: Osmunda vachellii

children.description: Osmundastrum cinnamomeum, commonly known as the cinnamon fern or the buckhorn fern, is a species of royal fern native to the Americas and Asia.
